g.text: 4 tails · dome over a hanging hem
9 lashes · two arcs meeting at a corner
an arch on two poles · a plate slung 1.12 radii under it
an egg on its side · 0.22 taper · overlapping rings
a sac hung heavy, narrow at the top · THE WEIGHT's draft, on the field
a strand, tall and boneless · TENDRIL's draft, on the field
the dead rock, with the rider that steers it
the body strung out behind its head
the cannon lobe turned inside out
8 lobes · pupil of 5 · a hole you see the field through
the pupil run out to the edge of its travel
the two beats the core is exposed
